'''Dejan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="quest" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Dejan.png|thumb|left|100px|Dejan's character model]]
Major Dejan was supposed to appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' mission "The Metal Swarm," which was cut from the game. However, he is still mentioned during the heroic mission "Total Elimination." His character model in the game files shows Dejan to be a male Togruta.
